+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Interactive one-episode controller for the RoboTwin 2.0 microphone handover.
+
+The process holds one Robot client for the whole episode. Send JSON lines on stdin:
+  {"op":"pose", "label":"pregrasp", "actions":[[left xyz+wxyz+grip, right xyz+wxyz+grip]]}
+  {"op":"obs", "label":"after_grasp"}
+Each response and all returned camera artifacts are saved under output/trajectory/.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "trajectory"
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+robot = Robot()
+print(json.dumps({"event": "connected", "spec": robot.spec()}), flush=True)
+
+
+def observe(label):
+    cams = ("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera", "observer_camera", "world_camera1")
+    result = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    folder = OUT / label
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, img in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(folder / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    for cam, depth in result.depth.items():
+        np.save(folder / f"{cam}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (folder / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps({"event": "observation", "label": label, "meta": result.meta,
+                      "saved": str(folder)}, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+
+
+def pose(label, actions):
+    a = np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32)
+    if a.ndim == 1:
+        a = a[None, :]
+    if a.ndim != 2 or a.shape[1] != 16 or a.shape[0] > 50:
+        raise ValueError("ee_pose actions must have shape (T<=50, 16)")
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", a, video="mp4", note=f"handover_mic:{label}")
+    folder = OUT / label
+    result.save(str(folder))
+    print(json.dumps({"event": "action", "label": label, "meta": result.meta,
+                      "proprio_last": None if result.proprio is None else result.proprio[-1].tolist(),
+                      "saved": str(folder)}, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+
+
+observe("initial")
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        command = json.loads(line)
+        op = command.get("op")
+        if op == "obs":
+            observe(command.get("label", f"obs_{time.time_ns()}"))
+        elif op == "pose":
+            pose(command["label"], command["actions"])
+        elif op == "joint":
+            a = np.asarray(command["actions"], dtype=np.float32)
+            result = robot.submit("joint_position", a, dt=float(command.get("dt", 0.05)),
+                                  video="mp4", note=f"handover_mic:{command['label']}")
+            folder = OUT / command["label"]
+            result.save(str(folder))
+            print(json.dumps({"event": "action", "label": command["label"], "meta": result.meta,
+                              "proprio_last": None if result.proprio is None else result.proprio[-1].tolist(),
+                              "saved": str(folder)}, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+        elif op == "quit":
+            print(json.dumps({"event": "quit"}), flush=True)
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown operation {op!r}")
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({"event": "error", "error": repr(exc)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
